reason: A utility plugin for observing loaded DeepSeek Harness capabilities, comparing their hashes with supplied expectations or pack locks, and issuing or verifying content-addressed receipts without executing the target capability.

summaries.zh: 用于观察 DeepSeek Harness 实际加载的能力、比对内容哈希并生成或离线验证内容寻址收据的工具插件。
summaries.en: A utility plugin that observes capabilities loaded by DeepSeek Harness, compares content hashes with supplied expectations, and issues or verifies content-addressed receipts.

capabilities: Observes loaded DSH skill definitions and computes content hashes
Reads bounded local resource directories when explicitly configured
Compares runtime observations with supplied expectations or pack-agent locks
Writes content-addressed receipt artifacts beneath an explicit workspace-relative directory
Provides offline CLI and in-memory MCP verification tools
